common_subset_adjudication.interpretation: Native and independent endpoint force/residual secants agree closely on the common 1,919-tet subset, while both differ from the center tangent by about 24%. The endpoint perturbation has measurable realized-direction differences and this single finite step may include curvature or unrecorded branch changes. The omitted tet prevents a complete independent assembled secant; this comparison does not identify a pure FP32 quantization floor or establish the derivative gate.
common_subset_adjudication.observed_predicate_scope: Only projected state[12] > accepted state[12] was compared; this is not a complete branch signature.

conclusion: The FP32 source transcription of frame, compensated F high/low, and ordinary Fdot reproduces the captured center inputs bitwise for all 1,920 tetrahedra. On all plus/minus rows where the independent FP64 projection converges, native element-force increments differ from the independent FP64 increments by about 1.7e-5 relative in aggregate. One plus medium row (tet 1691) does not converge under the independent projector, so the complete independent centered force/residual secant is unavailable. Native force/residual bookkeeping itself matches the captured residual delta to about 1.6e-5 relative, but the native centered residual secant remains 1.0948 relative away from center A. This evidence does not establish that native stress/force quantization explains the full gap; the missing row and finite-step/branch effects leave that attribution unresolved.
evidence_class: source-bound CPU material/force/residual adjudication; no production or physical qualification

failed_attempt_preservation.prior_attempt_outcome: output serialization failed when the filesystem ran out of space; the source script was copied byte-for-byte into this package before the compact rerun.

failure_examples.reason: RuntimeError: FP64 return map stalled iteration1 rows[0] norm[90.81492362]

limitations: The native FP32 frame quaternion, two-word deformation construction, and ordinary FP32 velocity-gradient path are transcribed from source125; reconstructed center F high/low and Fdot words match all 1,920 captured tets bitwise. Side F/Fdot words are produced by the same CPU transcription from exact native424 FP32 endpoint u/v words, but no separate side material-input capture exists at epsilon 2^-14.

The constitutive response/projection and force assembly are independent FP64 equations evaluated from those source-transcribed side F pairs and exact captured material/history inputs; they are not a bitwise clone of native FP32 projection/force accumulation.
Fdot is reconstructed and checked at center; the retained 15-state reference law is rate-independent, so Fdot is diagnostic and does not alter the projection equations used here.

This one epsilon identifies endpoint force/residual layers only; it does not establish a universal numerical noise floor, a smooth full-history derivative gate, convergence, material calibration, or physical qualification.
The run is a rejected Newton candidate with zero physical transactions.

source_update_path_audit.adjudication: Candidate velocity is incremented from the current Newton candidate, not reconstructed as accepted velocity plus one alpha-scaled correction. Displacement is then rebuilt from accepted displacement plus dt times that new candidate velocity. Thus the captured endpoint delta-u versus dt*delta-v relation is the relevant cross-sample check; alpha path and endpoint generation are distinct. No source evidence of a later alpha limiter was found.

alpha_publish.contract: tested alpha is published to FEM and coupled environment line-search state

armijo_trial_candidate.contract: starts from the current candidate; increments its v by alpha*correction; computes deltaV relative to accepted v; in reference-displacement mode rebuilds u=accepted u+dt*new candidate v and x=rest+u

commit_candidate.contract: starts from the current candidate; increments its v by the same published alpha times the FGMRES solution; computes deltaV relative to accepted v; in reference-displacement mode rebuilds u=accepted u+dt*new candidate v and x=rest+u

compensated_F_input.contract: when paper compensated flag and reference-u tet flag are set, F is rebuilt as two-word I+grad(u) in local material frame

runtime_order.contract: Armijo runs after geometry/contact alpha limiters; decision precedes normal FEM apply; no later alpha limiter found
